completeCard.name: Banish Unholy
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Up to three Undead or Fiends within 30 feet
completeCard.duration: Instantaneous; banishment rider lasts until end of target's next turn
completeCard.effect: Banish Unholy. Tags: divine, control. Each target makes a Wisdom save. Failure deals (S+1)d8 radiant damage and pushes it up to 15 feet directly away from you; success takes half damage and no push. exactComparisonCards.independentDisposition: Distinct class technique. WIS, radiant damage/push and next-turn rider are not the ordinary spell CHA/60-second proposal. Its nearest-legal return is comparison evidence, not a complete finite-cell termination rule.

completeCard.name: Verdict Absolute
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One Judgment Brand target; witnesses in your aura
completeCard.effect: For 3 rounds, your current Judgment Brand cannot be removed by an ordinary save or concealment effect. The Lay on Hands refill requires a meaningful nonsummoned hostile defeated in a real encounter; staged or willing sacrifices do not qualify.

originalObjects.value: Verdict Absolute — once per day, your Judgment Brand cannot be resisted: marked foes suffer max-dice smites, cannot teleport or become invisible, and if reduced to 0 HP you restore your full Lay on Hands pool; unmarked foes who witness the execution must save or become frightened until end of next turn.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: An actual No Escape mark is active on target T. T is unwilling and fails a legal Banishment save; compare T voluntarily electing failure to accept rescue.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Decide exact voluntary/forced transport predicate for these two branches; do not label all banishment voluntary or all willing transport forced.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: T was exiled before a No Escape or Reign of Ashes restriction could lawfully become active on it. The60-second deadline now arrives.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Resolve actual application legality first, then mandatory return versus the exact active transport restriction. No indefinite cell from a blanket blocker; no silently invented source exception.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: A Chain of Duty ally reaches0 inside the separate cell; its old origin anchor is20 feet from the Paladin.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Same-plane rescue condition is false. Anchor distance does not replace actual target plane/location; no free Paladin entry.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: A cell occupant with Wizard Dimensional Pocket attempts to create storage and enter it. Compare an active nonliving Construct occupant.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Living entry is expressly barred; a creature is not unattended material merely because nonliving. Do not confer a new cell escape through an inventory ability.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: A visitor has an independently legal interplanar route to the cell, actual knowledge and enough fitting space; arrival would occur before t60.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: The existing draft has no complete terminal state for that visitor. Review a finite entry/collapse protocol explicitly; neither absence of free return nor source expiry permits stranding/deletion.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: T uses an otherwise legal creature-creation ability inside the cell; a distinct creature would remain when t60 arrives.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Treat internally created bodies as well as visitors. A no-visitor rule alone does not close this case. Preserve real source costs and creature identity; specify finite terminal placement.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: Origin footprint is aboard a moving vehicle, or the origin surface becomes unsupported during exile.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Choose fixed-world anchor versus support-attached coordinates explicitly. The local draft proposes fixed origin and pre-change early return; evaluate real event boundaries and Falling, not a hidden force-wall reservation.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: One atomic source event changes T geometry and another body occupancy so the preserved anchor no longer fits. No intermediate state is exposed by that source.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Complete the draft unresolved atomic-change branch. Preemptive return cannot depend on retrospectively splitting an indivisible resolved event.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: T dies in the cell with genuine worn gear; separately a finite Null Disabled summon expires there.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Return actual surviving corpse/objects under their source identities; no resurrection, Hunt reset, recreated summon body, free loot or repeated corpse use.

newAuthoredReviewScenarios.initialState: Before the endpoint, T lawfully escapes elsewhere with some original gear and leaves other objects in the cell.
newAuthoredReviewScenarios.requiredResolution: Do not drag escaped T back. Settle every remaining real object once and close the cell by a finite rule, preserving consumed/moved object history; no duplicated cargo or new permanent plane.
